baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوَّٰمِينَ / شُهَدَآءَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ / خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Standing, witnessing, measuring, and divine knowledge form one accountability chain: the addressees continuously guard a public standard, disclose what is known, and remain answerable for the intended action behind the testimony.

activation_trace.role: Continuous care and guardianship make qawwamin an enduring custodial posture rather than a momentary pose.
Knowledge-bearing declaration makes witness the public disclosure function of that custodianship.
The upright scale supplies the external measure by which testimony is held straight.
Knowledge of an affair's interior makes hidden motive part of the accountability mechanism.
Intended action closes the chain by locating justice in performed conduct, not testimony alone.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks people to give fair testimony.
changed_reading.after: The ayah institutes a continuing custodial office: sustain an upright public measure for God, disclose by knowledge, and align the deed and its hidden motive with the testimony.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَـَٔانُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا۟ / ٱعْدِلُوا۟
baseline_models.mechanism: Hatred is treated as causal pressure that can recruit the agent into deviation. The negative prohibition and immediate positive repetition install justice as an active corrective barrier, not mere absence of overt prejudice.

activation_trace.role: Causing or loading someone into an act gives hatred a causal lever over conduct.
Hatred and enmity name the affective force that tries to operate that lever.
Right judgment and conduct supply the commanded counter-action.
Turning off the proper face supplies the failure mode that the repeated imperative reverses.
A barrier that repels harm makes taqwa the protective result of resisting affective capture.

changed_reading.before: Do not let dislike make you unfair.
changed_reading.after: Recognize hostility as pressure that can enlist conduct off its proper line, then actively restore justice as a protective firewall against that capture.

baseline_models.mechanism: The comparative does not collapse justice into taqwa. Balanced treatment is presented as the nearest practicable movement toward placing oneself under protection.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence and balancing provide the concrete operation from which movement begins.
Nearness, in place or meaning, turns the relation to taqwa into directed proximity.
Putting oneself in protection supplies the approached state without identifying it with the balancing act.

changed_reading.before: Justice is simply another name for piety.
changed_reading.after: Justice is the nearest actionable approach toward the protected state of taqwa, not a claim that the actor has already arrived there.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim clause in 5:2 identifies what hatred-driven failure looks like: crossing a boundary after a group has obstructed access. Its cooperation pair then gives the positive social form of the focus imperative, redirecting collective force from sin and aggression toward expansive good and protection.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence presents hatred as something that can cause or load the agent into conduct.
The focus occurrence names enmity as the causal pressure justice must resist.
Right judgment anchors the changed reading back in the focus command.
The repeated causative image makes the earlier obstruction a test case for the focus clause.
Repeated hatred binds the test case and focus to the same affective mechanism.
Exceeding the limit and doing wrong specifies the behavioral endpoint that hatred must not produce.
Mutual assistance moves the mechanism from private restraint to governance of coordinated action.
Expansive good supplies the constructive field toward which cooperation is redirected.
Self-placement in protection links the cooperative redirection directly to the focus's taqwa goal.

structural_cues: 5:2 repeats the focus sequence of causal loading, hatred, and a people, but gives transgression as the prohibited result.
The same ayah follows with two opposed cooperation commands, making collective alignment part of the anti-retaliation mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated clause, obstruction, boundary-crossing, and opposed cooperation fields; I infer that the earlier concrete case interprets the focus's more general command and that cooperation operationalizes justice. A live alternative is that 5:2 is only a parallel legal case and does not define every act of justice.

changed_reading.before: The focus regulates an individual's impartial judgment despite dislike.
changed_reading.after: The focus also regulates post-injury collective behavior: obstruction by an enemy cannot license boundary-crossing, and justice requires redirecting shared power toward good rather than aggression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Completion without deficiency, binding a contract, reaffirmed covenant, and an appointed guarantor convert qawwamin from generic moral steadfastness into a continuing office of covenant maintenance. Testimony by the upright measure verifies whether bound obligations are actually fulfilled.

activation_trace.role: Guardianship and sustained care anchor the covenant office in qawwamin.
Knowledge-bearing declaration provides the office's verification function.
The straight scale supplies a standard external to loyalty and hostility.
Full completion without deficiency defines what maintained obligation must deliver.
A binding and ratified undertaking supplies the durable object of custodianship.
The confirmed covenant extends binding obligation into remembered communal accountability.
The people's recognized guarantor gives the sustained justice posture an institutional analogue.

structural_cues: The window opens by commanding fulfillment of contracts and recalls covenant immediately before the focus.
After the focus, covenant is paired with appointed communal guarantors and specified performances.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, binding, covenant, and guarantor images; I infer that these make qawwamin a role that maintains obligations through measured testimony. The live alternative is a looser shared legal register without a specific institutional reading of qawwamin.

changed_reading.before: Qawwamin describes being morally firm during an isolated act of testimony.
changed_reading.after: Qawwamin describes occupying a durable guarantor role that keeps bound obligations complete and tests their performance by an upright measure even when group feeling pulls elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hostile intention forms, hands are extended, and those hands are restrained. Remembered restraint gives the focus an embodied sequence: acknowledge real threat, block its transfer into one's own deeds, and entrust the remainder rather than answering hand with hand.

activation_trace.role: Enmity anchors the sequence in the focus's actual hostile affect rather than an abstract calm case.
Protective blocking supplies the focus-side function of restraint.
Intended action anchors the hand sequence in what the addressees themselves do.
An intention cohering within the self supplies the initiating hostile pressure.
Extending and releasing the hand turns inner intent into imminent embodied action.
What hands acquire links the threatened limb to accountable deeds.
Prevention and restraint supply the decisive interruption between threat and retaliation.
Reliance supplies a non-retaliatory way to release control after one's own hand is restrained.

structural_cues: 5:11 puts a people's hostile intent, extended hands, restrained hands, taqwa, and reliance in one compact sequence.
The focus likewise joins a people, hostile affect, protective taqwa, and accountable action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile intent, hand-extension, restraint, accountable deeds, and reliance; I infer that remembered divine restraint becomes an embodied pattern for human non-retaliation in the focus. The alternative is that 5:11 offers reassurance only, not an ethical template for 5:8.

changed_reading.before: Justice means reaching a neutral verdict despite dislike.
changed_reading.after: Justice also means stopping hostile intent at the hand: real danger may be acknowledged, but it cannot be allowed to reproduce itself through one's own accountable action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Broken binding and recurring betrayal generate a credible ground for anger, yet pardon and graceful turning are commanded nearby; the next sequence depicts enmity and hatred as something incited and made adhesive. Justice can therefore preserve truthful witness to breach while interrupting the social propagation of its hostility.

activation_trace.role: Causal loading anchors the question of whether received hostility is passed onward into conduct.
Hatred supplies the affect whose propagation the model tracks.
Right judgment keeps interruption of hostility anchored in justice rather than denial of breach.
Unbinding what was fastened supplies a substantive violation that truthful witness must retain.
Deficient fidelity and trust make the breach recurrent rather than imaginary.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense supplies one possible interruption of retaliatory transmission.
Graceful turning away supplies a non-reproductive response that need not falsify the witness.
Incitement makes enmity an actively propagated social force rather than a static feeling.
Aversive recoil gives the propagated force its affective content and reconnects it to focus hatred.

structural_cues: 5:13 places pardon and graceful turning directly after covenant rupture and recurring betrayal.
5:14 then links forgotten obligation with incited enmity and hatred between groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real breach, pardon, graceful turning, incitement, and hatred; I infer that justice can interrupt the replication of hostility while testimony preserves the breach as fact. A materially live alternative is that pardon is adjacent discretionary mercy rather than a constituent operation of justice.

changed_reading.before: Justice after breach means proportionately answering the violation.
changed_reading.after: Justice may keep an exact witness to covenant failure while refusing to transmit its hatred onward; pardon or graceful disengagement can preserve justice when they interrupt retaliation rather than conceal evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exposure of what was hidden, illumination, gentle guidance, paths of peace, and a straight road spatialize the focus comparative. Justice is not only morally ranked near taqwa; it is the nearest visible next movement by which a biased decision can re-enter a protected, peace-directed route.

activation_trace.role: Nearness in place or meaning anchors the route model in the focus comparative.
A protective barrier supplies the destination toward which the nearer route tends.
Removing concealment makes hidden bias available for correction before it enters judgment.
Illumination makes the corrective route visible.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies movement rather than static moral rank.
An extended traversable path gives the movement a practical course.
Peace and reconciliation specify the social direction of the path.
The straight road gives justice's repeated correction a directional geometry.

structural_cues: 5:15 moves from concealed material to a manifest light.
5:16 clusters guidance, paths of peace, movement from darkness to light, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus nearness plus contextual exposure, light, guidance, peace-paths, and straightness; I infer a decision procedure in which justice is the nearest corrective step onto that route. The live alternative is that the path cluster describes guidance broadly and does not specifically proceduralize aqrab in 5:8.

changed_reading.before: Nearer to taqwa states an abstract moral ranking.
changed_reading.after: Nearer to taqwa also gives a navigational instruction: expose the bias, take the just next step, and thereby move onto a visible path directed toward protection and peace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a surprising ritual-to-ethical material analogy, not a lexical definition of justice. It remains anchored by the repeated standing root, focus protection, and the context's cleansing of hands and action; downstream prose should present it only as a possible procedural image for auditing bias before testimony.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing supplies the lexical hinge from the focus posture to the purification sequence.
Protective blocking keeps the analogy attached to the focus's stated direction.
Standing bodily before prayer activates a parallel preparation image for standing as a witness.
Washing away dirt supplies the exploratory image of removing affective residue before judgment.
What the hands acquire turns cleansed limbs into an audit image for accountable action.
Purifying self and action from ugliness gives the material cleansing image an ethical endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Justice begins when the witness announces a verdict.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, standing for justice begins with a purification audit of the interfaces of action, washing hostile residue from what one faces and what one's hands are about to do.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a surprising narrative-to-ethical transfer and should not be rendered as the lexical sense of qawwamin. It remains anchored in the focus root's rising-to-an-affair branch and the direct contextual contrast with sitting back under fear; downstream prose should qualify it as a motivational topology of just action.

activation_trace.role: Rising with resolve toward an affair makes qawwamin an active undertaking rather than verbal assent.
Fear of anticipated harm supplies the pressure under which active standing is tested.
The entrance supplies a threshold image for moving from professed principle into costly action.
Reliance enables passage through the feared threshold without requiring control of every result.
Sitting back from action supplies the narrative opposite of rising to sustain justice.

changed_reading.before: Qawwamin means holding a correct and stable opinion about justice.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, qawwamin means crossing the feared threshold into just action, opposed to sitting out while leaving the principle at the level of speech.

strongest_changes: The exact 5:2 parallel turns the focus into a rule against retaliatory boundary-crossing and extends it to collective cooperation.
Contract, covenant, and guarantor branches recast qawwamin as a durable accountability office rather than momentary firmness.
The restrained-hand sequence makes impartiality embodied: hostility must be stopped before it becomes one's own deed.
Pardon after real breach and the light-path sequence show justice interrupting propagated hatred while taking the nearest peace-directed route toward protection.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converts an inward danger into an inspectable process: hatred loads conduct, coordinated action can redirect it, hands can be restrained, covenant gives an external standard, and nearness becomes a route rather than a slogan.
remaining_uncertainties: Pardon and graceful turning may be adjacent mercy rather than operations internal to justice.
The purification and gate-standing readings are anchored analogies but remain too cross-domain to state without explicit qualification.
The exact functional distinction between qist as public measure and adl as corrective balancing remains open.
